REVENUE DEPARTMENT, GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI 
GUIDELINES FOR ISSUANCE OFOBC CERTIFICATE 
 
A. Eligibility Criteria 
I. The applicant is entitled forOBC Certificate of Delhiif 
 An individual who is a citizen of India. 
 OBC certificate has already been issued to any paternal blood relative (Father/ Uncle). 
 Anindividual who is a permanent resident of Delhi on or before 8th September 1993. 
 Caste applied for must be notified in Govt. of NCT of Delhi. 
 The applicant is not covered under Creamy Layer category as specified by the Govt. of India time to time. 
 Anyone who does not belong to OBC category can’t claim so on the virtue of marriage. 
 
II. The applicant is entitled for  OBCCertificate(Central)  for applying for  appointment to Posts under the 
Government of India if 
 An individual who is a citizen of India. 
 An individual who is currently residing in Delhi. 
 Caste applied for must be notified in the Government of India OBC List (Central) 
 An individual who is a permanent resident of Delhi on or before  8th September 1993 is eligible for OBC 
certificate of Delhi (Central)for applying for  appointment to Posts under the Government of India 
 If applicant have migrated to Delhi after 8th September1993 then  he/she w ill be eligible for OBC Certificate  
(Central) of the State to which he originally belonged to. 
 The applicant is not covered under Creamy Layer category as specified by the Govt. of India time to time. Please 
check and fill Annexure I for eligibility. 
 Anyone who does not belong to OBC category can’t claim so on the virtue of marriage. 
  
B. Documentsto be attached with the  Application Form 
1. Identity Proof of Parents (in case applying for minor) ( Any Oneis mandatory) – 
 Aadhaar Card  PAN Card  Ration Card with Photo 
 Voter ID Card  Passport   Driving License 
 Any Govt. issued document  
 
2. Identity Proof of Beneficiary (Any One is mandatory) – Same as the List in Col 1 above. For a minor, the letter from the 
School Principal (on letter head) or birth certificate in case of a minor less than 5 years of age would also be acceptable 
3. Present Address Proof of Beneficiary or Parents in case of minor( Any Oneis mandatory) – 
 Aadhaar Card  Voter ID Card  Driving License 
 Passport   Ration Card  Rent Agreement (Registered ) 
 Bank Passbook  Electricity Bill  Water Bill 
 Telephone Bill(Landline or Post-paid)  Gas Bill  Any Govt. issued document 
 
4. Permanent Address Proof of Beneficiary /Parents in case of minor (Any One is mandatory) – Same as List 
in Col No 3above. 
5. Case I:  Whose family has been residing in Delhi since prior to 1993; 
AND 
Where an OBC Certificate has been issued to brother/sister/ father or any other relative from paternal side 
Eligible for Delhi OBC Certificate  
List of the Documents Required: 
1. Completed application form along with self-declaration of the claim for Non-Creamy Layer in the prescribed 
format. 
2. Copy of the Caste Certificate of any relative from paternal side 
3. Proof of relationship of the applicant with caste certificate holder. 
4. One photo ID proof and one residential proof as per s.no.  2 and 3. ID proof of parent as per s.no. 1 will also be 
required in case applying for Minor.   
6. Case II: Whose family has migrated to Delhi after 1993; 
AND 
Where an OBC Certificate has already been issued to father of the applicant  from the State of Origi n of the 
applicant’s family  
Eligible for other state OBC certificate(respective State) 
List of Documents required: 
1. Completed application form along with Se lf declaration of the claim for Non -Creamy Layer in the prescribed 
format. 
2. Copy of the Caste Certificate of father of the applicant 
3. One photo ID proof and one reside ntial proof as per s.no 2 and 3.   ID proof of parent as per s. no. 1 will alsobe 
required in case applying for Minor. 
 
7. Case III: Whose family has been residing in Delhi since prior to 1993; 
AND 
Where No OBC Certificate has been issued to any relative from paternal side 
Eligible for OBC Central(Delhi State) certificate 
List of Documents required: 
1. Completed application form along with Self declaration of the claim for Non -Creamy Layer in the prescribed 
format. 
2. Proof of residence in Delhi since prior to  1993 as per s.no 2 proving stay in Delhi prior to 1993 
3. One photo ID proof and one residential proof as per s. no 2 and 3. .  ID proof of parent as per s.no. 1 will also be 
required in case applying for Minor. 
 
8. Case IV: Where an OBC  Certificate has already been issued to the applicant from Delhi/Other State 
Eligible for OBC Central Certificate 
List of Documents required: 
1. Completed application form along with Self declaration of the claim for Non-Creamy Layer in the prescribed format. 
2. Copy of  OBC  Certificate of the applicant 
3. One photo ID proof and one residential proof as per s.no 2 and 3. 
 
9. Citizen must provide signed copy of Self -Declaration form along with the application form. A compliance to 
Annexure I that the citizen does not belong to creamy layer as laid in Annexure I must also be provided along with 
the Self-Declaration Form. 
10. One Passport size Coloured Photograph of the Applicant(Size 5cm x 4.5cm Or 2”x1.75”) 
 Should include full face, front view and open eyes   should be of full head from top of hair to shoulder  
 should be in a plain white or off-white background  shouldn’t be shadows on the face or background 
 should have a natural expression (closed mouth)  should not include sunglasses or hats 
 
C. Important Note 
 Parents can only apply in case of minor(“minor” as per the provisions of the Indian Majority Act, 1875) 
 In case of minor, parent’s Address proof has to be appended. The ID proof has to be of minor. 
 Beneficiary’s/Parent’sself-attested copy of the original document to be produced while applying at Citizen Service 
Centre (CSC)and if applying online then document are to be uploaded in e -District application software.  Physical 
verification of some documents may be necessary at the counter even in case of online applications. 
 Scanned copy of Self- Declaration has to be uploaded while applying online and hard copy of declaration has to be 
submitted to the concerned SDM/Tehsildar/CSC by hand or speed post/registered post  along with Application 
/Acknowledgement number. 
 The beneficiary himself/herself  /any of his family member  should be present at the CSC for photograph orsubmit 
his/her photograph. In case of online application, applicant must upload beneficiary photograph (As per 
specifications above)
